summary: Kennametal filed an 8-K under Items 5.02, 8.01, and 9.01 announcing the appointment of Amanda Cole as Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer effective July 21, 2026, succeeding Judith Bacchus who will retire as Chief Administrative Officer on October 1, 2026. Ms. Cole joins from Wesco International and will enter into standard indemnification and officer employment agreements. No material terms such as price, premium, or deal value were disclosed. The filing is a routine officer appointment with no structural mechanics or regulatory clock, and does not constitute a special situation event.
